reason: The plugin periodically retrieves DeepSeek’s official service status data and presents overall status, component states, incidents, and uptime in the Web UI session header.

summaries.zh: 在 Web UI 会话头部定时显示 DeepSeek 官方服务状态、组件状态、事件和可用率。
summaries.en: Displays DeepSeek official service status, component states, incidents, and uptime in the Web UI session header.

capabilities: Periodically fetches an external service status page
Parses service status and incident data
Displays status and uptime information in the web UI
